title: Classify rational saturated-header Hurwitz orbits (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. Normalized saturated headers over Q in a fixed rational symplectic frame are Hurwitz equivalent exactly when these two invariants agree:

```text
embedded lattice L = sum_i Z x_i
intrinsic multiset {x_i + 2L} in L/2L
```

An explicit family indexed by positive odd m has vectors `(1/m,0), (0,m), (-1/m,m)`, the same ambient mod-2 reduction and covolume one, but pairwise distinct lattices and therefore pairwise distinct orbits. In dimension two, the lattice alone is sufficient.

DreamingOfClouds's merged [#6842](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6842) supplies the normalized structure, Hurwitz action and integral classification and explicitly excludes non-integral frames. The new step is the embedded-lattice invariant, transport to rational headers and the infinite odd-denominator obstruction. No predecessor scientific verifier is imported or replayed. Credit its #6832/#6833/#6836, CubeJerry #6839/#6840 and zxv #6726 lineage, and Brendle–Margalit's cited pure braid image theorem with A'Campo credited there. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

Before, #6842's theorem applies to integral headers in an integral frame. After, the proof gives the exact rational criterion and shows why ambient 2-local reduction alone loses information.

At head `9b09455d05349732f54704859dd3a31e1f747a77`, local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64 passes:

- Twelve rational initial headers in dimensions 2, 4, 6 and 8; 192 literal walk steps, each checking the full product, pairings, lattice, intrinsic residues and inverse move.
- Sixteen odd-denominator headers and all 120 pairwise lattice distinctions.
- One rational same-lattice pair with different intrinsic residue multisets.
- Five rejection controls.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct commands, both registered commands, metadata/source pins, staged whitespace and committed-byte/source-history preflight.
- A standalone optimized replay with Git absent from PATH and six read-only package files; all files remain unchanged.

Direct modes took 0.4705 s and 0.4960 s locally; the registered runner took 1.1893 s in total. These are timeout-budget observations, not performance improvements. Each registered command has a 120-second limit. The direct marker is `PASS_RATIONAL_HEADER_ORBIT_LATTICE`; the runner prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`; publication preflight prints `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/rational-header-orbit-lattice/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/rational-header-orbit-lattice/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rational-header-orbit-lattice
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rational-header-orbit-lattice --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 interpreter path may be substituted. Standard library only. The verifier writes nothing and emits a generated stdout receipt bound to hashes of all six package files. The written argument carries the universal claims; finite checks corroborate the new instances.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The exact equivalence permits only the stated normalized Hurwitz moves, with one fixed rational form and exactly n+1 units. It does not add rational conjugacy or rescalings as free operations. Residue multisets are compared in one common lattice, never in two independently chosen coordinate charts.

Higher-dimensional sufficiency cites the integral theorem and its pure braid image input. The lattice obstruction itself needs neither. This is not a bounded-length synthesis theorem, rational-header census, physical native word, site-mask program, paid frame conversion or favorable complete target/paid bill. Compiler, precision/tape, stock, supplier and outer obligations remain. Selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human review and formal proof-kernel verification were not run or claimed.

## Open next questions

Can one physically legal rational frame change join distinct header lattices at a favorable complete cost? Pin one literal root and conversion; charge native conversion, dirty restoration, movement and target effects. The algebraic classification supplies no such physical contract or price.

## Related open work

No open PR studying rational saturated-header Hurwitz equivalence or the embedded-lattice invariant was found in the targeted live search and complete overlap snapshot. #6842 is merged and is the cited integral predecessor. Searches are not a guarantee against unpublished overlap.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19538524). Delivered scope matches it.

The completion refresh inspected this account's nine other open PRs created after the CLAIM: #7178, #7179, #7180, #7181, #7182, #7183, #7185, #7186 and #7187. They study multiplicative-shell growth, formal A2 tariffs, Gaussian inverse norms, Clifford response sectors, local-algebra lift costs, a radical directed-cycle tariff, generic block signatures and sampler table sharing. None studies rational saturated-header Hurwitz equivalence or computes a competing lattice-orbit quantity. No extra scientific computations were run to check those contributions.

## CI notes

**Hosted CI did not certify this package.** At exact head `9b09455d05349732f54704859dd3a31e1f747a77`, [run 42993026387](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42993026387) completed with `plan` failed and package `replay` skipped.

The [plan job 130430231876](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42993026387/job/130430231876) failed in `Onboarding helper tests` on exactly one test among 760, with 24 skipped:

```text
test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record
AssertionError: '`make frontier7000-verify`' not found in the current CI verification documentation
FAILED (failures=1, skipped=24)
```

The raw AssertionError includes the stale document's entire current section, which still names #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. On base main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, `certificates/selected-result.json` already specifies `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still contains that #6030 section. Both files and the failing test are byte-for-byte unchanged by this PR. I inspected their base bytes and the actual job log; no test or job was rerun.

The same single failure, command mismatch and `760 tests / failures=1 / skipped=24` summary were confirmed directly in the failed-step logs of [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314), [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790), and [run 42992088329](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42992088329). Other reported runs were not inspected for this update.

The [package replay job 130432024315](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42993026387/job/130432024315) was skipped because planning failed. Only the local package verification described above has run. No repair, retrigger commit or workflow rerun was made; the shared documentation mismatch awaits maintainer repair.

## Merge Danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: isolated. Only one six-file research package is added.
